description: Consumer Affairs Authority - Consumer Affairs Authority Act No. 09 of 2003 Special Direction under Section 10(1) (b) (ii) directs all manufacturers & Traders of Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG)
categorisation: This gazette content contains a special direction issued by the Consumer Affairs Authority under the Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 09 of 2003. It establishes regulatory requirements for manufacturers and traders regarding the sale of Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG) cylinders, making it a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government structure/personnel announcement.
